summary: Enforce persisted max-wake and max-hours caps for babysit --watch, with deduplicated pause notes and status output (#1081).
migration_impact: No repository migration. Watch loops use local cap ledgers under .agentic/babysit/ and pause when either default spend cap is reached.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core to the release that contains watch cap integration.
2. Inspect saved usage with `gh plate pr babysit <n> --status`.
4. After a cap pause, start a new budget with `gh plate pr babysit <n> --watch --reset-caps`.
agent_notes: Babysit watch caps are enforced before and after each poll. Pass --max-wakes and --cap-hours to change the defaults. A cap pause posts at most one PR comment containing <!-- plate-babysit-cap -->. The ledger records cap_note_posted, and a later pause still searches newer comment pages for that marker. The --status option reports saved wake and elapsed-hour usage. A human must explicitly pass --reset-caps to start a new budget. Cap ledger filenames are length-prefixed so owner/name pairs that share a hyphenated slug do not share a budget.
